pr_title: Fixed wrongly handled not ready TSDB on web and API.
pr_body:
Two commits: 

1. Fixed federation.
   Signed-off-by: yeya24 <yb532204897@gmail.com>

EDIT by @bwplotka: 

2. Fixed all cases of not ready TSDB being wrongly handled.

* Fixed issue for federation.
* Ensured this will never happen again thanks to interfaces
* Fixes same issue for stats.
* Fixed bug in stats. It was:
   status.MaxTime = db.Head().MaxTime()
   status.MinTime = db.Head().MaxTime()
* Added tests for readiness.

Signed-off-by: Bartlomiej Plotka <bwplotka@gmail.com>

Fixes #7181
pr_comments: did you test this, especially early in prometheus start?
Let me fix it, will push commit to your PR, hope that's ok :hugs:

Ok, this should be ready for review @roidelapluie @yeya24 @beorn7 @brancz @brian-brazil :hugs: 

I think it makes sense to move to interfaces only, so we don't leak raw DB pointer anymore and ensure we can properly check the readiness and return meaningful errors. We happen to have an issue in more places than just one.

Also fixed undiscovered bug with status page: 

```
* Fixed bug in stats. It was:
   status.MaxTime = db.Head().MaxTime()
   status.MinTime = db.Head().MaxTime()
```

After this is merged I will cut rc.1
Nice comments, thanks for quick review :+1:
Merging on green (~2h) to unblock release if no objections.
